question: Should a manually resized Control UI composer height be one browser-local preference shared by all primary chat composers, or should it be scoped differently?
rationale: The implementation intentionally chooses global cross-conversation persistence, which changes the semantics of a new user preference; tests and a video can establish behavior but cannot determine the desired product contract.

options.title: Accept global browser-local sizing
options.body: Keep one resettable localStorage preference so the primary composer remains the same height while users switch conversations.

options.title: Scope height per conversation
options.body: Store the preference with conversation-scoped composer state so each chat can retain an independent drafting layout.

options.title: Keep resize session-only
options.body: Do not persist a manual height so each browser load begins with the existing automatic sizing behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept global browser-local sizing
recommendation.body: Keep one resettable localStorage preference so the primary composer remains the same height while users switch conversations.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor documented the concrete scope tradeoff and can apply a selected direction, although final product acceptance needs an OpenClaw Control UI maintainer.
